title: GunQuest
description:
GunQuest is an action-packed RPG, where you use firearms to combat fantasy creatures. Craft guns, explore an open world, team up with allies, and conquer the infinite plain in GunQuest!Interact with the DeveloperAlso, Psst... GunQuest has a discord server! Follow the development process and give input on the direction of the game!

Gameplay Features• Overworld Caravan Travel!
• Fast paced combat!
• Enemy Variety!
• Interesting NPCs!
• Dynamic Dialogue Options!

Features In Production• NPCs travel in tandem with the caravan!
• New playable characters!
• Native Tribe Weapons!
• Extended Map Size!
• Bullet Type Variety!
• Rune/Magic System for Guns!
• Crafting System!
• Caravan Upgrade System!
Find New Weapons!Fight Enemies!Interact with NPCs!
